description.en-US: Validate, explain and run PipeForge jobs on this machine, evaluate expressions and start the Web UI.
description.zh-CN: 在本机校验、解释和运行 PipeForge 作业，计算表达式，启动 Web UI。

description.en-US: Output format: table (default), json or yaml. json and yaml have the fields of the REST API.
description.zh-CN: 输出格式：table（默认）、json 或 yaml。json 和 yaml 的字段与 REST API 一致。

description.en-US: Language of messages and errors: en-US or zh-CN. Defaults to PIPEFORGE_LANG, then the system language.
description.zh-CN: 提示和错误的语言：en-US 或 zh-CN。默认取 PIPEFORGE_LANG，其次是系统语言。

description.en-US: Never use colours; also when NO_COLOR is set or the output is not a terminal.
description.zh-CN: 不使用颜色；设置了 NO_COLOR 或输出不是终端时也不使用。

description.en-US: Print results only, no progress or notes.
description.zh-CN: 只输出结果，不输出进度和提示。

description.en-US: Print engine and plugin logs and the full cause of errors.
description.zh-CN: 输出引擎和插件的日志，以及错误的完整原因。

description.en-US: Directory with plugin packages; repeat it or separate directories with the path separator. Defaults to PIPEFORGE_PLUGIN_PATH, then plugins/ of the installation.
description.zh-CN: 存放插件包的目录；可以重复使用，或用路径分隔符分隔多个目录。默认取 PIPEFORGE_PLUGIN_PATH，其次是安装目录下的 plugins/。

description.en-US: Also load the plugin modules of the source checkout at <root>, or of the one around the current directory, from their build output.
description.zh-CN: 额外加载 <root> 处（或当前目录所在）源码仓库中的插件模块，直接使用它们的构建输出。

description.en-US: Check job files without running them: syntax, variables, plugins, options, graph and schemas.
description.zh-CN: 校验作业文件但不运行：语法、变量、插件、选项、图和 Schema。

description.en-US: Job files, or directories whose .yaml, .yml and .json files are checked.
description.zh-CN: 作业文件，或目录（校验其中的 .yaml、.yml 和 .json 文件）。

description.en-US: A job variable, as name=value; repeat it for more. Wins over env.variables of the job.
description.zh-CN: 作业变量，写成 name=value，可以重复使用；优先于作业的 env.variables。

description.en-US: The planned time of the run, the base of null, as an ISO-8601 time such as 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z. Defaults to now.
description.zh-CN: 本次运行的计划时间，即 null 的基准，写成 ISO-8601 时间，例如 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z。默认为当前时间。

description.en-US: Show the plan of a job: settings, variables, nodes, options with their origin, schemas and warnings.
description.zh-CN: 显示作业的计划：设置、变量、节点、带来源的选项、Schema 和警告。

description.en-US: The job file.
description.zh-CN: 作业文件。

description.en-US: A job variable, as name=value; repeat it for more. Wins over env.variables of the job.
description.zh-CN: 作业变量，写成 name=value，可以重复使用；优先于作业的 env.variables。

description.en-US: The planned time of the run, the base of null, as an ISO-8601 time such as 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z. Defaults to now.
description.zh-CN: 本次运行的计划时间，即 null 的基准，写成 ISO-8601 时间，例如 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z。默认为当前时间。

description.en-US: Run a job file on this machine and wait until it ends. Ctrl-C cancels it.
description.zh-CN: 在本机运行作业文件并等待它结束。按 Ctrl-C 取消。

description.en-US: The job file.
description.zh-CN: 作业文件。

description.en-US: Run in this process. Required in this version; running on a cluster comes with the distributed runtime.
description.zh-CN: 在当前进程中运行。本版本必须指定；在集群上运行随分布式运行时提供。

description.en-US: Plan the job and print its plan, without running it.
description.zh-CN: 只生成并输出作业的计划，不运行。

description.en-US: After the run, print the run analysis: nodes, rates, wait times and the reconciliation.
description.zh-CN: 运行结束后输出运行分析：节点、速率、等待时间和对账结果。

description.en-US: The run was cancelled after the timeout of {0}.
description.zh-CN: 运行超过了 {0} 的超时时间，已被取消。

description.en-US: A job variable, as name=value; repeat it for more. Wins over env.variables of the job.
description.zh-CN: 作业变量，写成 name=value，可以重复使用；优先于作业的 env.variables。

description.en-US: The planned time of the run, the base of null, as an ISO-8601 time such as 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z. Defaults to now.
description.zh-CN: 本次运行的计划时间，即 null 的基准，写成 ISO-8601 时间，例如 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z。默认为当前时间。

description.en-US: Work with the expression language.
description.zh-CN: 使用表达式语言。

description.en-US: Evaluate an expression on one row and show the result and its type.
description.zh-CN: 用一行数据计算表达式，显示结果和结果类型。

description.en-US: The expression, in quotes.
description.zh-CN: 表达式，用引号括起来。

description.en-US: The row as a JSON object, e.g. {"amount": 1200, "city": "Hangzhou"}.
description.zh-CN: 一行数据，写成 JSON 对象，例如 {"amount": 1200, "city": "杭州"}。

description.en-US: The type of a column, as name TYPE, e.g. "amount DECIMAL(10, 2)"; columns without one get the type of their JSON value.
description.zh-CN: 列的类型，写成 name TYPE，例如 "amount DECIMAL(10, 2)"；没有声明类型的列使用其 JSON 值的类型。

description.en-US: The time zone of dates and times.
description.zh-CN: 日期和时间使用的时区。

description.en-US: Start the server on 127.0.0.1 with the plugins of this command and open the Web UI. Ctrl-C stops it.
description.zh-CN: 在 127.0.0.1 上用本命令的插件启动服务端，并打开 Web UI。按 Ctrl-C 停止。

description.en-US: The port of the server.
description.zh-CN: 服务端的端口。

description.en-US: Do not open the browser.
description.zh-CN: 不打开浏览器。

description.en-US: The server jar to start, instead of the one of the installation.
description.zh-CN: 要启动的服务端 jar，代替安装目录中的那个。

description.en-US: How many seconds the server may take to start.
description.zh-CN: 服务端启动最多等待的秒数。

description.en-US: Show the versions of the command, the connector API and Java.
description.zh-CN: 显示命令、连接器 API 和 Java 的版本。

description.en-US: Check this machine: Java, the installation, plugins, the server, Docker and the terminal encoding.
description.zh-CN: 检查本机环境：Java、安装目录、插件、服务端、Docker 和终端编码。

description.en-US: Print the completion script of a shell; load it with source <(pipeforge completion bash).
description.zh-CN: 输出 Shell 的补全脚本；用 source <(pipeforge completion bash) 加载。

description.en-US: bash or zsh.
description.zh-CN: bash 或 zsh。

description.en-US: Check, test and document plugins while they are developed.
description.zh-CN: 在开发过程中校验、测试插件并生成文档数据。

description.en-US: Check built plugin packages the way the engine uses them: descriptor, isolation, forbidden calls, components and documentation data.
description.zh-CN: 按引擎使用插件的方式检查构建好的插件包：描述文件、隔离、禁止调用、组件和文档数据。

description.en-US: Plugin packages: zip files, or directories they were extracted to.
description.zh-CN: 插件包：zip 文件，或解压后的目录。

description.en-US: Run the tests of a plugin project with Maven, the testkit contract among them.
description.zh-CN: 用 Maven 运行插件工程的测试，包括 testkit 契约测试。

description.en-US: The plugin project: a directory with pom.xml and src/main/plugin/plugin.yaml.
description.zh-CN: 插件工程：包含 pom.xml 和 src/main/plugin/plugin.yaml 的目录。

description.en-US: Only these testkit groups, separated by commas, e.g. options,types; the others are skipped.
description.zh-CN: 只运行这些 testkit 用例组，用逗号分隔，例如 options,types；其他用例组跳过。

description.en-US: Only the test classes that match, as Maven's -Dtest, e.g. *ContractTest.
description.zh-CN: 只运行匹配的测试类，同 Maven 的 -Dtest，例如 *ContractTest。

description.en-US: The Maven command to use; defaults to the nearest mvnw of the project, else mvn.
description.zh-CN: 使用的 Maven 命令；默认取工程或其上级目录中最近的 mvnw，否则使用 mvn。

description.en-US: Write the documentation data of a plugin project with Maven and show the options of its components, or check that it is current.
description.zh-CN: 用 Maven 生成插件工程的文档数据并显示各组件的选项，或者检查文档数据是否最新。

description.en-US: The plugin project: a directory with pom.xml and src/main/plugin/plugin.yaml.
description.zh-CN: 插件工程：包含 pom.xml 和 src/main/plugin/plugin.yaml 的目录。

description.en-US: Where the documentation data is written; defaults to src/generated/plugin-docs of the project.
description.zh-CN: 文档数据的写入位置；默认为工程的 src/generated/plugin-docs。

description.en-US: Compare the documentation data with what the components export instead of writing it; exit with 3 when it is stale.
description.zh-CN: 不写入，而是把文档数据与组件导出的内容比较；过期时以 3 退出。

description.en-US: The Maven command to use; defaults to the nearest mvnw of the project, else mvn.
description.zh-CN: 使用的 Maven 命令；默认取工程或其上级目录中最近的 mvnw，否则使用 mvn。

description.en-US: Start, stop and show the local development environment: the docker compose project in dev/ with databases ready for CDC, a fault-injection proxy and monitoring.
description.zh-CN: 启动、停止和查看本地开发环境：dev/ 中的 docker compose 工程，包括已为 CDC 准备好的数据库、故障注入代理和监控。

description.en-US: Start the development environment and wait until every service is healthy, then show its status.
description.zh-CN: 启动开发环境，等待所有服务健康后显示其状态。

description.en-US: Start only these services and what they depend on, e.g. mysql. Defaults to all services.
description.zh-CN: 只启动这些服务及其依赖，例如 mysql。默认启动全部服务。

description.en-US: Also start the services of the s3 profile: MinIO with its buckets.
description.zh-CN: 同时启动 s3 profile 中的服务：MinIO 及其存储桶。

description.en-US: How long to wait for the services to become healthy, e.g. 90s or 5m.
description.zh-CN: 等待服务变为健康的最长时间，例如 90s 或 5m。

description.en-US: The directory of the environment, with its docker-compose.yaml. Defaults to dev/ of the source checkout around the current directory, then dev/ of the installation.
description.zh-CN: 开发环境所在的目录，其中有 docker-compose.yaml。默认取当前目录所在源码仓库的 dev/，其次是安装目录的 dev/。

description.en-US: Stop the development environment, the optional services included.
description.zh-CN: 停止开发环境，包括可选服务。

description.en-US: Also delete the data volumes; the sample data is created again on the next start.
description.zh-CN: 同时删除数据卷；下次启动时重新创建示例数据。

description.en-US: The directory of the environment, with its docker-compose.yaml. Defaults to dev/ of the source checkout around the current directory, then dev/ of the installation.
description.zh-CN: 开发环境所在的目录，其中有 docker-compose.yaml。默认取当前目录所在源码仓库的 dev/，其次是安装目录的 dev/。

description.en-US: Show the state, health and ports of every service; exits with 1 when nothing runs or a service is not healthy.
description.zh-CN: 显示每个服务的状态、健康情况和端口；没有服务运行或有服务不健康时以 1 退出。

description.en-US: The directory of the environment, with its docker-compose.yaml. Defaults to dev/ of the source checkout around the current directory, then dev/ of the installation.
description.zh-CN: 开发环境所在的目录，其中有 docker-compose.yaml。默认取当前目录所在源码仓库的 dev/，其次是安装目录的 dev/。

description.en-US: Success.
description.zh-CN: 成功。

description.en-US: An error, such as a server that did not start, or an unexpected error.
description.zh-CN: 错误，例如服务端没有启动，或者意外错误。

description.en-US: The command was used wrongly: an unknown option, a missing argument or a malformed value.
description.zh-CN: 命令用法有误：未知选项、缺少参数或取值格式不对。

description.en-US: A job, an option or an expression is invalid.
description.zh-CN: 作业、选项或表达式不合法。

description.en-US: The run failed.
description.zh-CN: 运行失败。

description.en-US: The run was cancelled after --timeout.
description.zh-CN: 运行因 --timeout 超时被取消。

description.en-US: A file or an object does not exist.
description.zh-CN: 文件或对象不存在。

description.en-US: Authentication failed or a permission is missing (with a server, in a later version).
description.zh-CN: 认证失败或缺少权限（连接服务端时，后续版本提供）。

description.en-US: The run was cancelled.
description.zh-CN: 运行被取消。

description.en-US: The run succeeded, but its row counters do not reconcile.
description.zh-CN: 运行成功，但行数计数不能对账。
